prompt: My test asserts that a computed residual equals approx(0.0) and it fails even though the residual is 3e-10. Why, and how should I write the assertion?
criteria: Explains relative tolerance scales with the expected value, so approx(0.0) only allows the default absolute tolerance of 1e-12
Recommends passing an explicit abs= tolerance sized to the numerics
Gives a corrected assertion, e.g. approx(0.0, abs=1e-8)
Does not claim approx(0.0) always passes

prompt: A test for my bootstrap resampling function fails about 1 in 20 runs in CI. How should I make it reliable without hiding real bugs?
criteria: Uses a seeded local generator such as np.random.default_rng(seed) rather than global np.random.seed
Suggests passing the generator into the function under test
Distinguishes deterministic seeded tests from statistical tests with tolerances
Avoids recommending blanket retries or skipping the test as the fix
